title: Apollo's memory was woven by hand, literally
body: The Apollo guidance computer stored its fixed software in core rope memory: wires threading tiny magnetic cores, a wire through a core meaning 1, around it 0. Teams of women at Raytheon wove the programs strand by strand, and changing code meant reweaving. Software was, for a while, a textile.
